entities.summary: Ivan Anatolyevich Savin is a Russian former professional ice hockey defenceman who predominantly played in his hometown with Mechel Chelyabinsk and Traktor Chelyabinsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). In January 2020, Savin became the general manager for Traktor Chelyabinsk.
